barks.text: Everything here is signed for. Sign here.
The Warden's seal is old work. Older than the order.
Citadel first, valley second. That is the job.

1.speaker: Quartermaster Rook
1.text: Rook is inventorying a crate that was inventoried this morning.

3.speaker: Quartermaster Rook
3.text: Plate that stops one hit and slows the rest of the fight, and a sabre that will not break. Take the sabre.

4.speaker: Quartermaster Rook
4.text: I sell to whoever signs. The paper says the citadel owns the gear until you die, at which point it owns it again. Nobody has come to collect yet.

5.speaker: Quartermaster Rook
5.text: My commander. She has not slept properly since the seal went quiet, and she thinks I have not noticed.

2.speaker: Quartermaster Rook
2.text: Well? The day is not getting shorter.

choices.text: Who is the High Warden to you?
